# IRS Form 1098-T Tax Form Information Student Billing

- **Source URL**: [https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/1098](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/1098)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T07:34:43.297Z

## Content

[[Frequently Asked Questions - Form 1098-T Tax Benefits Student Billing|## Form 1098-T Frequently Asked Questions]]       
## General Information About the 1098-T Form
 
If you are a US resident for tax purposes, you may be eligible to claim a tax credit or deduction on your federal tax return if you paid qualified educational expenses to the University of California. The American Opportunity Credit, the Lifetime Learning Credit, and the Tuition and Fees Deduction allow taxpayers to reduce their federal income tax based upon qualified tuition and fees paid, assuming the taxpayer meets eligibility requirements.
 
The determination as to whether you qualify for these benefits should be made in consultation with your personal tax advisor or the Internal Revenue Service.
 
The University of California cannot give you tax advice or decide as to whether you qualify for these tax benefits.
 
The 1098-T form is used by eligible educational institutions to report information about their US resident students to the IRS as required by law. As an eligible educational institution, UC Berkeley reports certain financial and identifying information regarding US resident students for which UC Berkeley has received payments of "qualified education expenses" for the corresponding tax year. Included in the 1098-T form are qualified charges that were paid and financial assistance received for the corresponding tax year. Loans are excluded and not reported on the 1098-T form.
 
In general, if you are a degree candidate (undergraduate or graduate student enrolled in a degree program at UC Berkeley) the portion of your fellowship used to pay for tuition, fees, and related required course expenses (required of all students) is excludable from your gross income (not considered taxable). For more information on tax free fellowships, please refer to the Tax Free Scholarship and Fellowship Grants section of [IRS Publication 970 (PDF file)(link is external)](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p970.pdf). Some fellowships are considered taxable. If your fellowship is nonexcludable (not used to pay for tuition, fees, and related required course expenses), your fellowship may be considered taxable. Please keep in mind that U.S. citizens and residents for tax purposes (permanent resident, refugee, or asylee) do not have Federal or State taxes withheld from their nonexcludable fellowship payments from the university. And, the university is not required to report this income to Federal and State tax agencies. The university also does not issue a W-2 equivalent to students for reporting nonexcludable fellowship income (though it is reported on your 1098-T Form). If you are a U.S. citizen or resident for tax purposes, you may be required to make estimated quarterly tax payments directly to the IRS or California Franchise Tax Board on your graduate fellowship payments.
 
Please use [Worksheet 1-1 of IRS Publication 970 (Tax Benefits for Education)(link is external)](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p970.pdf#page=7&zoom=100,0,44) to figure the amount of a scholarship or fellowship grant you can exclude from gross income.
 
To simplify reporting and to promote the best customer service for students and their families, the University of California contracts with TAB Services to provide the 1098-T form. For more information, please visit the [TAB Services website(link is external)](https://www.tsc1099.com/Login1098.aspx) or call TAB Services Customer Support toll-free at (888) 220-2540.
      ![Decorative separator line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line_alpha_lawrence_berkeley_blue_3840x40.png?itok=RwgWrXM3&timestamp=1710958243)      [[Accessing Your 1098-T Form Online Student Billing|## Accessing Your 1098-T Form Online]]       [[Understanding your IRS Form 1098-T Student Billing|## Understanding your IRS Form 1098-T]]       [[SSN ITIN Solicitation and Other Student Data Student Billing|## SSN/ITIN Solicitation and Other Student Data]]       ![Decorative separator line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line_berkeley_blue_lawrence_alpha_3840x40.png?itok=qdqtZSxf&timestamp=1710958257)      
## UC Berkeley Extension
 
UC Berkeley Extension issues a 1098-T form separately from the UC Berkeley Main Campus. For more information about UC Berkeley Extension 1098-T FAQ’s please visit the [SSN and ITIN FAQ(link is external)](https://extension.berkeley.edu/static/studentservices/ssn-faq/index.jsp) page.
      ![Decorative separator line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line_alpha_lawrence_berkeley_blue_3840x40.png?itok=RwgWrXM3&timestamp=1710958243)      
## Resources
 
- [[Frequently Asked Questions - Form 1098-T Tax Benefits Student Billing|Form 1098-T Tax Benefits Frequently Asked Questions]] 
- For more information about tax credits, deductions, and/or your 1098-T form: 
- [IRS website(link is external)](https://www.irs.gov/) 
- [IRS Publication 970 (Tax Benefits for Education) (PDF file)(link is external)](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p970.pdf) 
- [IRS Form 8863 (Education Credit) (PDF file)(link is external)](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f8863.pdf) 
- [IRS Form 8917 (Tuition and Fees Deduction) (PDF file)(link is external)](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f8917.pdf) 
- For specific questions about your 1098-T form: 
- [TAB Services website(link is external)](http://www.tsc1098t.com/) 
- TAB Services toll free: (888) 220 2540 
- UC Berkeley’s Federal Tax ID Number is 94-6002123

The university offers a variety of institutional student loans to eligible students.
 
To learn more about applicant and borrower requirements, the application process, and loan specifics, select the name of the loan program(s) in the table below.
 
Current borrowers can also review their promissory note for additional terms and conditions.
       ProgramBorrower CriteriaLoan Information   [University Bar Study Loan(link is external)](https://www.law.berkeley.edu/admissions/jd/financial-aid/forms/) Graduating “3L” Law students  
Grace Period: 7 months

# International Payments via Convera Student Billing

- **Source URL**: [https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/convera](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/convera)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T07:34:43.298Z

## Content

## Contact
 
### Convera Support
 
#### Email
 
[StudentSupport@convera.com(link sends e-mail)](mailto:StudentSupport@convera.com)
 
#### Phone
 
Local: 1 402 884 3041
 
Toll-Free: 1 877 218 8829
 
International: [Convera Contact(link is external)](https://students.convera.com/#!/contacts)
 
#### Payment Tracking
 
[Convera Track Your Payment(link is external)](https://students.convera.com/#!/tracking)
 
### Student Billing
 
If you have questions about your student billing account, please contact [Cal Student Central(link is external)](https://studentcentral.berkeley.edu/).
 
#### Phone
 
510 664 9181
 
#### Address
 
120 Sproul Hall, Berkeley, CA 94720
 
#### Hours
 
Monday through Friday
9:00 am to Noon, 1 pm to 4:00 pm
 
#### Email
 
[Open a case through Cal Student Central(link is external)](https://studentcentral.berkeley.edu/open-case)
 
## Convera Infosheets
 
- [English (PDF) (PDF file)](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/convera_infosheet_english.pdf) 
- [Chinese (PDF) (PDF file)](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/convera_infosheet_chinese.pdf)
          
## Overview
 
Convera's international payments option is a way for UC Berkeley international students to pay their Student Billing account. This secure payment option allows you to choose a foreign currency, obtain a locked-in, competitive exchange rate, and, when completed, have the payment credited directly to your Student Billing account.
 
- There are no transaction fees from Convera or UC Berkeley, though you may be charged a transaction fee by your bank. However, since the Convera transaction is in-country, the fee may be less than an inter-country wire transfer. 
- You will not be charged additional fees by intermediary banks reducing the funds UC Berkeley receives. This ensures UC Berkeley receives the amount you intend to pay; there are no hidden fees. 
- The exchange rate is competitive when compared to most bank retail rates. 
- Payments include all of the necessary reference information for the payment to post directly to your Student Billing account. 
- Payments will be transmitted electronically to your Student Billing account, ensuring timely posting, typically 2 to 5 business days after you initiate the payment. The traditional wire transfer from your bank to our bank requires manual posting which causes delays. 
- The Convera exchange rate is valid for 72 hours after the transaction is initiated, taking the uncertainty out of the total payment amount.
      ![Decorative line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line-berkeley_blue_dark_3840x10.png?itok=ZaEE5pH4&timestamp=1688082258)      
## Instructions
 
### 1. Get ready
 
- Determine how much you are going to pay to your Student Billing account 
- Your account balance can be viewed from the 'My Finances' tab in CalCentral 
- Enable pop-ups in your computer's browser 
- If pop-ups are blocked, you may not be able to see the payment instructions at the end, so be sure to elect to have a copy sent to your email address
 
### 2. Log In to [CalCentral(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/)
 
- [https://calcentral.berkeley.edu(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/)
 
### 3. Click the 'My Finances' menu tab
 
- From the CalCentral home page, click the 'My Finances' menu tab
 
### 4. Click the 'Make Payment' button
 
- Navigate to the 'Billing Summary' section on the 'My Finances' page and click the 'Make Payment' button 
- After clicking the 'Make Payment' button, a new window will open and you will be signed in to the Transact portal
      ![Screenshot of the CalCentral My Finances page with Make Payment button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/calcentral_my_finances_page_with_make_payment_button.jpg?itok=URifnVr9&timestamp=1606254773)      
### 5. Click the 'Make a payment' button
 
- From the Transact 'Overview' page, click the 'Make a payment' button to initiate the transaction
      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Overview page with Balance summary](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_overview_page_balance_summary.jpg?itok=I7zT3jqu&timestamp=1615243018)      
### 6. Confirm the Amount you wish to pay
 
- From the 'Pay Amount' page, enter the amount you wish to pay and click the 'Checkout' button
      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Make a Payment page with Pay Amount option](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_make_a_payment_page_pay_amount.jpg?itok=IvJ5mN_8&timestamp=1615504265)      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Checkout button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_checkout_button.jpg?itok=Nfkze-G4&timestamp=1671663894)      
### 7. Select the 'International Payment' option
 
- From the 'Payment Method' page, select the 'International Payment’ option and click the 'Continue' button
      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Make a Payment page showing the International payment option](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_make_a_payment_page_payment_method_international_payment_option.jpg?itok=8QoswsXp&timestamp=1615504387)      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Continue button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_continue_button.jpg?itok=uKTBIIm3&timestamp=1615242642)      
### 8. Select the 'Convera' option
 
- From the next 'Payment Method' page, select the 'Convera' payment option and click the 'Continue' button 
- Rates will be shown after transferring to Convera 
- International payments are processed by Convera 
- To complete your payment, your information will be provided to Convera and you will be directed to the Convera website 
- Your activity on Convera's website is governed by the [Convera privacy policy(link is external)](https://www.convera.com/en-us/compliance-legal/online-privacy-statement)
      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Make a Payment page showing the Convera payment option](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_make_a_payment_page_payment_method_convera.jpg?itok=PjECQETM&timestamp=1671665062)      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Continue button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_continue_button.jpg?itok=uKTBIIm3&timestamp=1615242642)      
### 9. Get a quote
 
At this point you will be redirected to the Convera website.
 
- Select the country that you are initiating the payment from in the 'Paying fees from' drop down menu 
- If your local currency is not an available option, you will need to select US Dollars (USD) from the drop down menu to complete the transaction 
- Important: Once USD is selected, ensure popup blocker is removed in order to complete the process 
- The Amount Due field will be automatically populated from Transact 
- Click the 'Get a quote' button
      ![Screenshot of the Convera Get a quote page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/convera_get_a_quote_page.jpg?itok=WvFBwpUa&timestamp=1671666732)      
### 10. Choose a way to pay
 
- Select a payment option available for a particular currency
      ![Screenshot of the Western Union Choose a way to pay page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/western_union_choose_a_way_to_pay_page_0.jpg?itok=oNSfSYUe&timestamp=1606253721)      
### 11. Confirm your student details
 
- Confirm your student details: 
- Student/Payer ID 
- First Name 
- Last Name 
- Email Address 
- Click the 'Next' button
      ![Screenshot of the Western Union Student Details page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/western_union_student_details_page_0.jpg?itok=T0aIfWSi&timestamp=1606253802)      
### 12. Enter the payer’s details
 
- Choose 'Who will be making this payment?' (either the student or someone else) and/or enter the payer’s details 
- Check the checkbox at the bottom of the page to indicate that you agree to the Terms of Use and have reviewed the Online Privacy Statement 
- Click the 'Proceed to Payment' button
      ![Screenshot of the Western Union Payer Details page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/western_union_payer_details_page.jpg?itok=aqEf3u-g&timestamp=1606253763)      ![Screenshot of the Western Union Agree and Proceed to Payment buttons](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/western_union_agree_and_proceed_to_payment_buttons.jpg?itok=QvGO1mtT&timestamp=1606253699)      
### 13. Make a payment
 
- Visit your local bank within 72 hours to complete your payment 
- Print the instructions, the receipt, and the Reference Number available in Transact 
- Take this information to your local bank to authorize a bank-to-bank transfer 
- Be sure to take along a valid proof of identity 
- Your local bank will transfer the funds to Convera’s local bank 
- Convera will transfer US dollars to UC Berkeley once the funds settle 
- Please allow 2-5 business days to complete 
- Confirm receipt of payment to your UC Berkeley Student Billing account: 
- CalCentral > MyFinances > Transaction Details
      ![Screenshot of the Western Union Print Instructions page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/western_union_print_instructions_page_0.jpg?itok=of5TZqIM&timestamp=1606253782)      
### 14. Track your payment
 
Once your payment is made, you can track it online or receive text updates through the [Convera Track your Payment(link is external)](https://students.convera.com/#!/tracking) page.
      ![Decorative line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line-berkeley_blue_dark_3840x10.png?itok=ZaEE5pH4&timestamp=1688082258)

# International Payments via Flywire Student Billing

- **Source URL**: [https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/flywire](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/flywire)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T07:34:43.298Z

## Content

## Overview
 
UC Berkeley has partnered with Flywire to provide our international students with a secure payment method that simplifies the payment process. With Flywire, you can pay online from banks and countries around the world, usually in your home currency and payment method.
 
- Pay from accounts in your home country, typically in your currency for most countries 
- Flywire will send funds in US Dollars directly to UC Berkeley 
- Offers payment methods like local bank transfer, credit cards, and e-payments, making the process familiar and convenient for you 
- Avoid unnecessary bank fees and receive favorable foreign exchange rates with final price disclosed up front 
- Track the progress of your payment anytime 
- Flywire's multilingual Customer Support is available 24 7 using multiple channels including live chat and WeChat
      ![Decorative line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line-berkeley_blue_dark_3840x10.png?itok=ZaEE5pH4&timestamp=1688082258)      
## Instructional Videos
 
- [How to Make an International Payment to UC Berkeley (AI generated)(link is external)](https://share.synthesia.io/13566797-0563-47a8-ab11-56e312c9a1f6) 
- [How Flywire Works (English)(link is external)](https://vimeo.com/189693395) 
- [How Flywire Works (Chinese)(link is external)](https://v.youku.com/v_show/id_XNDQyNjU1MjYwMA==.html)
      ![Decorative line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line-berkeley_blue_dark_3840x10.png?itok=ZaEE5pH4&timestamp=1688082258)      
## Instructions
 
### 1. Get ready
 
- Determine how much you are going to pay to your Student Billing account 
- Your account balance can be viewed from the 'My Finances' tab in CalCentral 
- Enable pop-ups in your computer's browser 
- If pop-ups are blocked, you may not be able to see the payment instructions at the end, so be sure to elect to have a copy sent to your email address
 
### 2. [Log In to CalCentral(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu)
 
- [https://calcentral.berkeley.edu(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/)
 
### 3. Click the 'My Finances' menu tab
 
- From the CalCentral home page, click the 'My Finances' menu tab
 
### 4. Click the 'Make Payment' button
 
- Navigate to the 'Billing Summary' section on the 'My Finances' page and click the 'Make Payment' button 
- After clicking the 'Make Payment' button, a new window will open and you will be signed in to the Transact portal
      ![Screenshot of the CalCentral My Finances page with Make Payment button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/calcentral_my_finances_page_with_make_payment_button.jpg?itok=URifnVr9&timestamp=1606254773)      
### 5. Click the 'Make a payment' button
 
- From the Transact 'Overview' page, click the 'Make a payment' button to initiate the transaction
      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Overview page with Balance summary](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_overview_page_balance_summary.jpg?itok=I7zT3jqu&timestamp=1615243018)      
### 6. Confirm the Amount you wish to pay
 
- From the 'Pay Amount' page, enter the amount you wish to pay and click the 'Continue' button
      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Make a Payment page with Pay Amount option](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_make_a_payment_page_pay_amount.jpg?itok=IvJ5mN_8&timestamp=1615504265)      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Continue button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_continue_button.jpg?itok=uKTBIIm3&timestamp=1615242642)      
### 7. Select the 'International Payment' option
 
- From the 'Payment Method' page, select the 'International Payment’ option and click the 'Continue' button
      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Make a Payment page showing the International payment option](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_make_a_payment_page_payment_method_international_payment_option.jpg?itok=8QoswsXp&timestamp=1615504387)      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Continue button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_continue_button.jpg?itok=uKTBIIm3&timestamp=1615242642)      
### 8. Select the 'Flywire' option
 
- From the next 'Payment Method' page, select the 'Flywire' payment option and click the 'Continue' button 
- Rates will be shown after transferring to Flywire
      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Make a Payment page showing the Flywire payment option](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_make_a_payment_page_payment_method_flywire_payment_option.jpg?itok=v4vVwcpJ&timestamp=1615330823)      ![Screenshot of the CashNet Continue button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/cashnet_continue_button.jpg?itok=uKTBIIm3&timestamp=1615242642)      
### 9. Select your country and enter your payment amount
 
At this point, you will be redirected to the Flywire website, berkeley.flywire.com.
 
- From the 'Payment Info / Your Payment' page, select your country in 'The payment will come from' drop down menu 
- Enter your payment amount in the 'University of California Berkeley receives' field 
- Note: the amount will be formatted in the destination currency (US Dollars in this case) 
- Click the 'Next' button
      ![Screenshot of the Flywire Your Payment page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_your_payment_page.jpg?itok=Mzj84SHm&timestamp=1606253431)      
### 10. Select your preferred payment method
 
- From the 'Payment Method' page, select your preferred payment method from options provided 
- Depending on your country, you will see various payment methods including bank transfer, credit card, Alipay, and more
      ![Screenshot of the Flywire Select Payment Method page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_select_payment_method_page.jpg?itok=fqNa-PaI&timestamp=1606253369)      
### 11. Enter the payer's information
 
- From the 'Payer Information' page, enter the payer's information 
- Email 
- First Name 
- Family Name 
- Address 
- City 
- State / Province / Region 
- Zip Code / Postal Code 
- Phone Number 
- Payment account holder's name 
- Identification Number 
- If you agree to Flywire's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, check the box next to: 
- I have read, understand, and agree to the Flywire Terms of Use and Privacy Policy 
- Click the 'Next' button
      ![Screenshot of the Flywire Payer Information page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_payer_information_page.jpg?itok=G2KCNEYc&timestamp=1606253350)      ![Screenshot of the Flywire Payer Information page with Next button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_payer_information_page_with_next_button.jpg?itok=zoVgH5jI&timestamp=1606253327)      
### 12. Enter your student information
 
- From the 'Info for the Receiver' page, enter your student information for UC Berkeley: 
- Contact information 
- The person filling out this form is 
- Payment information 
- Payment Type 
- Term 
- Student information 
- Student ID 
- First Name 
- Last Name 
- Date of Birth 
- Student Email Address 
- In the 'Payment Information' section, check the box next to: 
- I agree to pay only the account balance due as stated on my CalCentral-MyFinances tab online. I understand that any payments made in excess of amount currently due may be sent back to the remitter account. 
- Click the 'Next' button
      ![Screenshot of the Flywire UCB Information page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_ucb_information_page.jpg?itok=HpKBLvP0&timestamp=1606253412)      ![Screenshot of the Flywire Student Information page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_student_information_page.jpg?itok=tlcuiN5O&timestamp=1606253389)      
### 13. Review and confirm your payment information
 
- From the 'Review and Confirm Payment Information' page, review and confirm the following information: 
- Payment information 
- Payment method 
- Payer information 
- Contact information 
- Student information 
- Click the 'Pay' button
      ![Screenshot of the Flywire Confirm Payment Information page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_confirm_payment_information_page.jpg?itok=xcZ8jVN4&timestamp=1606253301)      ![Screenshot of the Flywire Confirm Payer Information page](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_confirm_payer_information_page.jpg?itok=MTcebRGE&timestamp=1606253273)      ![Screenshot of the Flywire Confirm Information page with Pay button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/flywire_confirm_information_page_with_pay_button.jpg?itok=ax-HDPxN&timestamp=1606253247)      
### 14. Track your payment
 
At this point, your payment has been sent to Flywire.
 
Once your payment is received, Flywire will process your payment and send it to UC Berkeley along with your information for easy posting.
 
You can track your payment with the tracking link provided via email or SMS, or create a Flywire user account to view your payment record anytime by logging in.
      ![Decorative line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line-berkeley_blue_dark_3840x10.png?itok=ZaEE5pH4&timestamp=1688082258)      
## Contact
 
### Flywire
 
For payment questions or assistance, please contact Flywire multilingual 24 7 Customer Support:
 
#### Phone
 
+1 800 346 9252
 
#### Email
 
[support@flywire.com(link sends e-mail)](mailto:support@flywire.com)
 
#### Web
 
[flywire.com/contact(link is external)](https://www.flywire.com/company/contact)
 
### Student Billing
 
If you have questions about your student billing account, please contact [Cal Student Central(link is external)](https://studentcentral.berkeley.edu/).
 
#### Phone
 
510 664 9181
 
#### Address
 
120 Sproul Hall, Berkeley, CA 94720
 
#### Hours
 
Monday through Friday
9:00 am to Noon, 1 pm to 4:00 pm
 
#### Email
 
[Open a case through Cal Student Central(link is external)](https://studentcentral.berkeley.edu/open-case)
      ![Decorative line](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/line-berkeley_blue_dark_3840x10.png?itok=ZaEE5pH4&timestamp=1688082258)

Jennay Arzu (she/ her) is a Fall 2023 transfer student at UC Berkeley majoring in Legal Studies & Social Welfare with a minor in Education. She has been a part of NSS since Summer 2025 starting off as an Orientation Leader. Coming into her fifth year she brings a wide-range of experiences from her involvement in the Caribbean Student Association, *bridges* multicultural coalition (BRRC), and Stiles Hall where she supports non- traditional k-12 students transition into higher education such as navigating college applications. She is interested in a career in higher education or social work and appreciates the amazing work experiences UC Berkeley has provided her. In her free time, she enjoys going to the gym, traveling to different countries, and spending time with family and friends.

# Lily Castiel - Golden Bear Orientation

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/about-us/student-leaders/student-coordinators/shayra-nawsheen](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/about-us/student-leaders/student-coordinators/shayra-nawsheen)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.648Z

## Content

[![Lily smiling wearing a blue sweater that reads "Berkeley"](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/Lily.png)](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/about-us/student-leaders/student-coordinators/lily-castiel/) 
Lily Castiel (she/her) is a Senior studying Environmental Sciences and Data Science. She has been with NSS for 4 years as an Orientation Leader, two time Orientation Mentor, and now as a Student Coordinator. Lily is currently undertaking an honors senior thesis where she is predicting site viability for underground carbon storage. Lily is excited to work with so many student leaders and welcome the new students to the university! In her free time, Lily loves attending Cal sporting events like football and gymnastics, listening to music, and spending time outdoors!

321e34e9b2549901.content:
# Make a Gift - Golden Bear Orientation

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/make-a-gift](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/make-a-gift)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.644Z

## Content

UC Berkeley’s orientation is part of a long tradition of welcoming new undergraduate students and their families and supporters to our campus. Orientation can provide the spark to positively affect a student’s years at Berkeley. We are thrilled to help our new Golden Bears begin at Berkeley on a sure path, to explore their passions, to understand the meaning of being a Berkeley student, and, of course, to have fun.
 
We’re taking orientation to a new model, which includes:
 
- Online prepping, advising, and enrolling 
- On-campus activities that will engage students academically and connect them socially
 
![GBO](https://live-wp-sa-gbo-1.pantheon.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/make-a-gift.jpg)
 
## Background
 
Golden Bear Orientation takes off from what, for many years, we fondly called CalSO. For about 50 years, our campus has accomplished new student orientation through Cal Student Orientation (CalSO) during the summer before fall semester begins.
 
Over the past year, university leadership, including administration and faculty, have engaged in discussion about the undergraduate experience, and, specifically, the role of new student orientation. The outcome resulted in changing our approach to welcoming new undergraduates to UC Berkeley.
 
## Our New Model
 
Beginning in fall 2017, we will host one comprehensive and lengthy orientation for incoming students shortly before the start of classes, as opposed to shorter summer sessions that were held under the CalSO model. We also plan to recruit and train 1,000+ student leaders, which is a win-win both for incoming and current students.
 
## Our Goals
 
Ultimately, the new Golden Bear Orientation model seeks to:
 
- provide our new Golden Bears with one common experience 
- nurture a sense of belonging 
- harness new technologies and adapt to changing needs 
- lay the foundation for each student to build a strong intellectual identity
 
## How You Can Help
 
We hope you can help. All contributions are welcome and will make a difference in students’ lives. For alumni, we hope you remember how critical orientation was to your own Berkeley journey. For members of our current Cal community (faculty, staff, students, and families), we hope you strengthen our campus culture by helping give new students a warm welcome and firm foundation as they begin at Berkeley. And for members of the larger community, we hope you join us in our goal of providing access, academics, and engagement as a public university.
 

 
If you have any questions, concerns, or ideas, please direct them to New Student Services: [nss@berkeley.edu](mailto:nss@berkeley.edu)

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/about-us/nss-staff/m-antovich](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/about-us/nss-staff/m-antovich)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.648Z

## Content

[![decorative image](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/Micki-.png)]([[Micki Antovich - Golden Bear Orientation]]) 
Director | [estuesta@berkeley.edu](mailto:estuesta@berkeley.edu)
 
Micki has been a member of the NSS team since 2015. Micki grew up in Oregon and studied mathematics at the University of Oregon. As a student, she was involved in orientation, sorority life, and leadership programs. Micki traveled as a leadership consultant following graduation. After traveling, Micki completed her MEd in postsecondary administration and student affairs from the University of Southern California, where she worked in fraternity and sorority life, judicial affairs, and student support systems. She most recently worked at Sonoma State University with student organizations. In her free time Micki bakes and reads.

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/new-students](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/new-students)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.640Z

## Content

To all of our new freshmen and transfer students: We’re happy you are coming to UC Berkeley! Get ready for a comprehensive and fun Golden Bear Experience.
 
## What to Expect
 
**Overview:** Your Golden Bear Experience consists of the following components: Golden Bear Advising, Golden Bear Prep, Golden Bear Orientation and Getting Your Bearings.
 
### Check your Emails
 
From May to August for Fall 2026 students*, you will receive emails with important information and approaching deadlines for the Golden Bear Experience. Check your UC Berkeley email account and CalCentral regularly and be sure to follow instructions and deadlines to ensure a smooth on-campus orientation, successful academic advising, and proper course enrollment.
 
**October to January for Spring 2027 students*

# Nominate a Student - Golden Bear Orientation

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/how-to-get-involved/student-leaders/nominate-a-student](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/how-to-get-involved/student-leaders/nominate-a-student)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.643Z

## Content

Do you know an amazing UC Berkeley student who shows leadership potential? The position is open to undergraduate students of all colleges and majors. Nominate a student (or students) to become a Golden Bear Orientation Leader by [completing this simple online form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSej7uROzdRcYxnRSyVbXZUiXi16HNfseC4uGPqx2_co8O70WQ/viewform). (You can find a [[Page not found - Golden Bear Orientation|full description of the position and its responsibilities here]].)
 
Orientation Leaders will receive these perks:
 
- Career/professional development 
- Extending the “Berkeley family” and learning more about campus 
- Exploring the Bay Area with new students 
- Receiving recognition across campus from many departments 
- Getting free UC Berkeley gear 
- Experiencing those unexpected intangibles, [[Page not found - Golden Bear Orientation|as expressed by previous GBO leaders]]
 
Reach out to [nss@berkeley.edu](mailto:nss@berkeley.edu) if you have any questions about the role.

# Online Payments Student Billing

- **Source URL**: [https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/payments-and-refunds/online-payments](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/payments-and-refunds/online-payments)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T07:34:43.295Z

## Content

## Making a Payment Online via CalCentral
 
### 1. [Log In to CalCentral(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/)
 
- [https://calcentral.berkeley.edu(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu)
 
### 2. Click the 'My Finances' menu tab
 
- From the CalCentral home page, click the 'My Finances' menu tab
 
### 3. Click the 'Make Payment' button
 
- Navigate to the 'Billing Summary' section on the 'My Finances' page and click the 'Make Payment' button
      ![Screenshot of the CalCentral My Finances page with Make Payment button](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/sites/default/files/styles/openberkeley_image_full/public/calcentral_my_finances_page_with_make_payment_button.jpg?itok=URifnVr9&timestamp=1606254773)      [## Log In to CalCentral
   (link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/)       
## Online Payment Options
      
### 529 College Savings Plan
 
Students and delegates have the option to pay their charges online via their 529 College Savings Plan.
 
A $10.00 non-refundable convenience fee will apply to electronic 529 payments.
      [[529 Savings Plans Student Billing|## Savings Plans Available for Use with Transact Payments]]       
### e-Check/ACH
 
Students can pay their charges online via e-Check/ACH with no additional fees.
 
To do so, please refer to the instructions for [[Online Payments Student Billing|Making a Payment Online via CalCentral]].
 
Please note: Multiple dishonored payments may result in your inability to remit eCheck payments without further notice indefinitely. Additionally, you may experience a financial hold on your account.
      
### Credit and Debit Cards
 
A non-refundable service fee applies to credit and debit card payments. The fee is 2.95% for domestic card payments and 4.25% for international card payments. The minimum service fee for card transactions over $20 and less than $102 will be $3.
 
UC Berkeley accepts the following major card brands:
 
- Visa 
- Mastercard 
- Discover 
- American Express 
- JCB

# Parents & Supporters - Golden Bear Orientation

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/parents-supporters](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/parents-supporters)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.642Z

## Content

Congratulations on your student’s acceptance as an undergraduate to UC Berkeley!
 
Your student will first complete online modules addressing academics and life at Berkeley and then will [[Page not found - Golden Bear Orientation|participate in Golden Bear Orientation, which will take place in Fall 2026]].
 
While your students are transitioning to the campus community, here are some resources just for parents and student supporters.
 
There is an orientation just for Cal parents/supporters; find out specifics, including agenda details, on our [[Parents & Supporters Orientation - Golden Bear Orientation|Parents & Supporters Orientation page]].
 
**Not a parent? No problem!**
 
Cal Parents and the Letter Home series are useful for anyone who serves as a support system for a Berkeley undergraduate.
 Resources   
- Cal Parents Websiteadd
[Cal Parents](http://calparents.berkeley.edu/) provides many resources for parents, guardians, and families of all UC Berkeley students. You'll find a resource guide, Facebook community, and updates on campus policies.
- Letter Home Newsletteradd
[Letter Home](https://calparents.berkeley.edu/get-involved/letter-home) is a newsletter specifically geared to families of undergraduates at UC Berkeley, published by [Cal Parents](http://calparents.berkeley.edu/).
- Fees, Requirements, Etc.add
You may learn about fees, requirements, and other important matters on our [[Policies - Golden Bear Orientation|Policies page]]. If you or your student has other questions about the Golden Bear Experience, including Golden Bear Orientation, that are not included elsewhere, please also see our [[Golden Bear Orientation Overview - Golden Bear Orientation|FAQs page]].

# Parents & Supporters Orientation - Golden Bear Orientation

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/parents-supporters/parents-supporters-orientation](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/parents-supporters/parents-supporters-orientation)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.642Z

## Content

## **Parent and Supporters Orientation Program**
 
*Updated: Wednesday, May 27, 2026*
 
The Parent and Supporters Orientation is a program led by New Student Services and Cal Parents & Families where parents and supporters can learn more about their student’s next steps integrating into the Berkeley campus, and participate in asking student panelists questions related to*financial aid, academic support, professional development opportunities, and social life* at Cal.
 

 
We will be hosting one session:
 
**Time:** Wednesday, August 19 10:00 am – 12:00 pm
 
**Location:** Zellerbach Hall, Zellerbach Auditorium
 
*We will be providing English, Spanish, and Mandarin captioning via the GBO-specific Stream2Text link that will be provided at the program.*
 
We recognize that this is a very busy and impactful time for your family. While we would love for you to join us, please know that spending time with your student is also very important. In addition, your student may be moving into University Residence Halls (Housing determined date of either August 17, 18, or 19 pending student housing assignment) and checking into Golden Bear Orientation (August 19) during the session.
 
Due to capacity and in an effort to provide space for as many Parents and Supporters as possible, your student may not be able to attend the session with you. **Due to Zellerbach Auditorium capacity, attendance will be on a*****first come, first served basis*****.**
 
We will also be recording the session and publishing it on this site after the program is over (early September) in case you are unable to attend. We will also livesteaming this session in case you are unable to attend and would like to join virtually. Live stream link will be added closer to the date of the program.
 
### **Campus Partners**
 
For any questions you may have prior to the orientation program, you can visit our campus partners website linked down below:
 Campus Partners   
- Cal Parents - Bienvenidos por parte de CalParentsadd
Visit us at [calparents.berkeley.edu](https://calparents.berkeley.edu/) | Contact us at [calparents@berkeley.edu](mailto:calparents@berkeley.edu)
- Cal Student CentraladdVisit us at [studentcentral.berkeley.edu](https://studentcentral.berkeley.edu/) | Contact us at 510-664-9181
- Residential Life - Vida ResidencialaddVisit us at [reslife.berkeley.edu](https://reslife.berkeley.edu/) | Contact us at 510-642-3213
- University Health Services: Health and Wellnes - Servicios de Salud Universitarios: Salud y BienestaraddVisit us at [uhs.berkeley.edu](https://uhs.berkeley.edu/) | Contact us at 510-642-2000 [Self-Help for Parents webpage](https://uhs.berkeley.edu/counseling/self-help/for-parents) and [Parents and Community page](https://uhs.berkeley.edu/parents-community)
- Financial Aid and Scholarships Office (FASO) - Oficina de Becas y Ayudas EconómicasaddVisit us at [https://financialaid.berkeley.edu/how-aid-works/appeals-special-circumstances/parent-guide/](https://financialaid.berkeley.edu/how-aid-works/appeals-special-circumstances/parent-guide/)
- Understanding Billing and Payments - Entendiendo lo Cobros y PagosaddVisit us at [studentbilling.berkeley.edu](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/) | Contact us at 510-664-9181
- Office of the Registrar - La Oficina del RegistradoraddVisit us at [registrar.berkeley.edu](https://registrar.berkeley.edu/) | Contact us at 510-664-9181 or [guide@berkeley.edu](mailto:guide@berkeley.edu)
 

 Parent and Supporter Orientation FAQs   
- Do I need to sign up for Parent and Supporter Orientation?add
You do not need to sign up for Parent and Support Orientation. Our orientation is open to all parents or supporters of incoming undergraduate students on a first come, first serve basis. We highly encourage arriving on time to guarantee your spot.
- Is there a cost associated with Parent and Supporter Orientation?addThere is no fee associated with the Parent and Supporter Orientation. It is free for all parents or supporters.
- Can I stay with my student during Golden Bear Orientation?addIncoming students will be attending orientation with their orientation leaders and new student group. To encourage students to find connections on campus, we recommend that they stay with their group the entire time without their guests.
- What do I need to bring to Parent and Supporter Orientation?addWe do not require any guest to bring anything to Parent and Supporter Orientation. We encourage guests to bring their own water bottles as there will not be any provided with this event.
- May I bring children to Parent and Supporter Orientation?addParent and Supporter Orientation welcomes all guests that are wanting to gain information about our campus community.
- Are there disability services/accommodations during Parent and Supporter Orientation?addNew Student Services works with the [Disabled Students’ Program (DSP)](http://dsp.berkeley.edu/students/new-students) and [Disability Access and Compliance](https://dac.berkeley.edu/home) to provide accommodations for PSO. If you require accommodations for a disability (visible or invisible) to fully participate in PSO, please email us at [nss@berkeley.edu](mailto:nss@berkeley.edu)****. We appreciate as much advance notice as possible to better prepare to address your needs.
- How can I get involved on campus as a parent, grandparent, or guardian?addWe encourage all supporters to get involved in our campus community. One method is by joining [Cal Parents Ambassadors](https://calparents.berkeley.edu/get-involved/cal-parents-ambassadors). This volunteer group is dedicated to enhancing the experience of Berkeley students and their families. Through this opportunity, you are able to serve as an advocate and representative for the university at volunteer events such as move-in activities, Parent Weekend, Cal Day, and Admission Receptions.
- How do I receive campus information about events, programs and activities?addThe university asks that all new students complete the [Parent Information Form](https://calparents.berkeley.edu/parent-support/update-parent-info)[,](https://calparents.berkeley.edu/parent-support/update-parent-info) which can be accessed under Tasks in CalCentral. Although completion of this form is voluntary, the information provided will help the university keep families informed about campus events, activities and programs. You may also submit your contact information on the Cal Parents website ([calparents.berkeley.edu/update/](http://calparents.berkeley.edu/update/)).
- How can I access my student’s information?addThe [Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA)](http://registrar.berkeley.edu/ferpa.html) is a federal law that protects the privacy of student records and prohibits University staff from disclosing certain information to parents or other individuals without the permission of the student. Students may grant permission to [delegates who are parents, guardians, spouses, or any other person](https://studentcentral.berkeley.edu/student-information-access/delegate-access/) to view enrollment information, enrollment information plus grades, and/or financial information (e.g. pay bills, view financial aid). This allows parents or guardians to pay your tuition/fees, view enrollments, view grades, or any combination of the three.
- Where do I access information about all things related to being a parent and supporter?add[The Resource Guide for Parents](https://calparents.berkeley.edu/resource-guide-cal-parents-families) provides you with helpful information about the university and the network of resources available to your student on our campus. Our hope is that you will use this guide to support your student along their educational path.

1dec717cbdeff781.content:
# Policies - Golden Bear Orientation

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/policies](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/policies)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.643Z

## Content

This page is in the process of being updated for Fall 2026 and covers basic policies for the Golden Bear Experience, which includes Golden Bear Advising, Golden Bear Prep, and Golden Bear Orientation. Updates will be made here and communicated via email as plans are solidified for GBO programming.
 
*Updated March 16, 2026*
 
## Participation Requirements
 
- Participation for all newly admitted undergraduate students is required for Golden Bear Advising, Golden Bear Prep, and Golden Bear Orientation. There are elements of each which are mandatory for each student; that is, not completing them can adversely affect your enrollment at UC Berkeley. *Note: Any event that is tied to your enrollment will be clearly identified.* 
- Fall 2026 Golden Bear Orientation will occur in person. See below for details on how the program will be adapted to meet unique needs, accommodations, and the exemption process. 
- See the [[GBO Sample Schedule - Golden Bear Orientation|GBO Sample Schedule]] for details about the overall schedule, including a breakdown of virtual and in person events. 
- Each component of Golden Bear Orientation is designed to help your transition to Berkeley.
 
## Student Needs for Fall 2026 Golden Bear Orientation
 
Participation in GBO is integral to your successful transition to UC Berkeley. However, there are circumstances that could be a barrier to your successful participation — not only in GBO but also in engagement with classes and community building throughout the year. We have identified a variety of barriers but this is not an exhaustive list:
 
- dependent/child care 
- illness (yours or others in your household) 
- COVID-19 isolation or quarantine order 
- unexpected family emergencies 
- active military duty 
- financial hardship, if there is a need to take time away from full-time employment 
- accessibility (physical, religious, alternate media, etc.) 
- access to technology 
- international visa concerns 
- COVID-19 vaccine policy compliance
 
*Important Note: Please reach out to our office if you have any questions about what constitutes a barrier to your participation.*
 
## Fall 2026 GBO Student Needs Questionnaire: Accommodations, Exemptions and Unique Experiences
 
Please fill out the [Golden Bear Orientation Fall 2026: Exemption and Accommodations Form](https://forms.gle/xEq35hfyYUv9S1kYA) if you have extenuating circumstances preventing you from engaging during GBO in person. Our goal is to help you navigate not only GBO, but also all of Berkeley. We ask that you use this form to notify New Student Services as soon as possible so our team has time to find the best solutions to meet your needs.
 
**Key Deadline:** In order to be approved for an exemption from in person GBO programming, you must submit the above form by **Sunday, July 19, 2026.**
 
**Exceptions:** There may be exceptional circumstances that arise after that date. If this is the case, please reach out to New Student Services via email (nss@berkeley.edu).
 
Once you’ve submitted the form, our team will work with you individually to work on possible solutions. We recognize that, if there are barriers to your participation in GBO, these barriers will likely impact your entire Berkeley experience.
 
We often find that UC Berkeley students, while advocates of those around them, do not always advocate for themselves, feel like they can ask for support, and/or know what support may be available. We encourage you to share what you are experiencing (if you feel comfortable), even if other environments have not made adjustments for your circumstances because we are committed to your transition to UC Berkeley.
 
## Fees & Payments
 
The New Student Programming Fee (NSPF) covers expenses related to Golden Bear Advising, Golden Bear Prep, Golden Bear Orientation, and Getting your Bearings. You will be assessed a fee on your first semester CalCentral bill. The New Student Programming Fee is $550 for incoming Fall 2026 undergraduates ($370 for UCEAP students). Those who receive a full exemption will have the New Student Programming Fee removed.
 
As orientation is mandatory for all new undergraduate students, so is the fee. If applicable, look to your financial aid package to see if this fee will be covered by financial aid in the form of the “New Student Grant.” If you have financial concerns related to the New Student Programming Fee, please complete the [Golden Bear Orientation Fall 2026: Exemption and Accommodations Form](https://forms.gle/xEq35hfyYUv9S1kYA). The programming fee covers:
 
- Golden Bear Advising and Golden Bear Prep pre-arrival modules 
- Golden Bear Orientation programming (no additional funds will be needed to participate in any part of the GBO program) 
- Getting Your Bearings programming 
- Please refer to our Office of the Registrar [Tuition & Fees](https://registrar.berkeley.edu/tuition-fees-residency/tuition-fees) page for more details on student fees.
 
## UCEAP Student Participation
 
UCEAP students are no longer required to attend Golden Bear Orientation (GBO), but are invited to opt into participation in the five day, in person GBO August 19-24, 2026. This change was made to reflect the unique needs of UCEAP students studying at Berkeley.
 
UCEAP students can opt into attending Golden Bear Orientation (GBO) in person by completing the [Fall 2026 UCEAP GBO Opt-In Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe8aT5pYhkP5iA22GBmeVgPC5k3ZaTaAwIvng5ywcb9GPhBxA/viewform)by the deadline of **July 19, 2026**. Note that this form requires you to be logged into your UC Berkeley email account (bMail). Submission of the [Fall 2026 UCEAP GBO Opt-In Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe8aT5pYhkP5iA22GBmeVgPC5k3ZaTaAwIvng5ywcb9GPhBxA/viewform) will provide full access to the five-day program and require payment of the EAP New Student Programming Fee of $370.
 
Requests to opt into the program after July 19, 2026 will be reviewed on a case by case basis and will require participants to pay the EAP New Student Programming Fee of $370.
 
UCEAP students will still receive [[Golden Bear Prep - Golden Bear Orientation|Golden Bear Prep International]], an online module meant to introduce students to life outside the classroom prior to arriving on campus and must attend the required [Virtual EAP Orientation with Berkeley International Office (BIO)](https://internationaloffice.berkeley.edu/students/exchange) on Wednesday, August 19, 2026 whether or not they choose to opt into GBO in person.
 
Questions? Reach out to New Student Services via email ([nss@berkeley.edu](mailto:nss@berkeley.edu)) and our team will help your transition to UC Berkeley.

730a16968516f406.title: Refunds Student Billing
730a16968516f406.content:
# Refunds Student Billing

- **Source URL**: [https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/payments-and-refunds/refunds](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/payments-and-refunds/refunds)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T07:34:43.295Z

## Content

## Overview
 
Refunds will be issued to students when the account has an eligible overpayment from personal funds or financial aid. Please refer to the 'My Finances' page in [CalCentral(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/) for a current account balance and list of refunds.
 
Please note that if a credit balance is created with an account balance due, the credit balance may apply towards the account balance before the refund is issued. Regardless of the due date of the account balance, the credit balance automatically applies towards the account balance, reducing the refund amount. For specific account questions, please contact [Cal Student Central(link is external)](https://studentcentral.berkeley.edu/services-areas-support/).
      
## Personal Payments
 
Overpayments from personal funds are released for refund 15 days from the date of payment posting. Refunds of $10,000 or greater require additional review which may delay the refund process. Credit Card refunds will be issued after the add or drop deadline to the credit card used to make the payment.
 
Please note: Flywire overpayments will be refunded via Flywire to the account used to make the payment. Flywire may reach out to you to confirm banking information before issuing the refund. Please refer to the [Refund Process: A Quick Overview(link is external)](https://help.flywire.com/hc/en-us/articles/360013702240-Refund-Process-A-Quick-Overview) page for more information about the Flywire Refund process.
      
## Financial Aid
 
If your financial aid payments exceed your charges, the extra funds will be issued to you as a refund about one week after payments are posted. Refunds are issued as early as one week before the beginning of each term. The actual timing of your refund depends on when your financial aid was applied to your account. Please check [CalCentral(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/) to monitor your aid payment dates so that you can estimate the date of any expected refund.
 
You will get an email letting you know when your refund is available either via direct deposit or as a paper check.
 
### Recommendation
 
We strongly recommend you sign up for direct deposit since that is the fastest and safest way to receive your funds.
 
If you do not have direct deposit, then a paper check will be mailed to your local address within 10 business days. Please make sure you review and update your local address information in [Cal Central(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/).
 
### Please Note
 
UC Berkeley does not require that students open an account with any financial institution. Students may choose to receive credit balances, or refunds, through any US banking institution of their choice or via a paper refund check.
      
## Direct Deposit
 
- Refunds, graduate student stipends, and any non-payroll university payments to students (except Emergency Loan checks) can be directly deposited to your bank account 
- Some outside agency payments may be processed via direct deposit, while some may not 
- Student employees can have their paychecks deposited automatically to their bank account each payday 
- Please contact your hiring department for a special form and more information
 
For more information about direct deposit, please visit our [[Frequently Asked Questions - Direct Deposit Student Billing|Direct Deposit Frequently Asked Questions]] page.
      [[Frequently Asked Questions - Direct Deposit Student Billing|## Direct Deposit Frequently Asked Questions]]       
To add, change, or cancel your Direct Deposit information online, please visit the [Direct Deposit Enrollment for Students(link is external)](https://eftstudent.berkeley.edu/) secure website.

# Registration and Administrative Holds Student Billing

- **Source URL**: [https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/billing/registration-and-administrative-holds](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/billing/registration-and-administrative-holds)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T07:34:43.295Z

## Content

Effective March 1999; Updated August 2021
 
When a student has failed to meet his or her financial obligations to the university, including unpaid fees totaling $100 or more, 60 days past due Billing and Payment Services is authorized under the Campus Policy on Student Registration Blocks to place a hold on a student's registration and diploma until the financial obligation is satisfied.
      
## Notification
 
Except where required by extraordinary circumstances, Billing and Payment Services must provide the student at least ten (10) working days notice of the impending hold and the reasons for such action. Such written notice shall be sent to the student's most recent known address and must contain:
 
- A notification that the student has the right to request in writing a hearing in advance of the imposition of the hold for the purpose of disputing the claimed obligation; and 
- A notification that the student has the right to be represented, to present information and witnesses, and to question the information relied upon by the university
 
### Written requests should be addressed to:
 
University of California, Berkeley
Billing and Payment Services
2610 Channing Way Rm 228 MC#1111
Berkeley, CA 94720
      
## Hearings
 
All hearings concerning disputed financial obligations shall be conducted informally by Billing and Payment Services, and should provide ample opportunity for the student to present his or her position regarding the disputed obligation. Within five (5) working days of the hearing, Billing and Payment Services shall issue a written report of their findings, which shall include their determination in the case and, if the student's challenge to the imposition of the hold is not upheld, a notification that the student has the right to appeal the outcome to the Office of the Registrar.

# SSN ITIN Solicitation and Other Student Data Student Billing

- **Source URL**: [https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/ssnitin-solicitation-and-other-student-data](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/ssnitin-solicitation-and-other-student-data)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T07:34:43.299Z

## Content

## SSN/ITIN Solicitation and Other Student Data
 
All US citizens, resident aliens, and nonresident aliens who intend to or who will file a US income tax return for the purpose of receiving an educational tax credit need to provide their SSN/ITIN to the university. To verify your eligibility for education tax credits, UC Berkeley is required by federal law to report your Social Security Number (SSN) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN) and other pertinent information to the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) on Form 1098-T.
 
In section 6109 of the Internal Revenue Code, the IRS requires that we request you to provide your SSN/ITIN. Without a valid SSN or ITIN, UC Berkeley will report the educational expenses paid by you in this tax year without this information, and your ability to claim an eligible tax credit may be delayed.
 
If you are not required by the IRS to have an ITIN and complete an income tax return, you are not required to provide the information.
 
International students who are nonresidents for tax purposes are ineligible for the education tax credit and may disregard the solicitation. Please refer to the [Nonresident vs. Resident for Tax Purposes(link is external)](https://internationaloffice.berkeley.edu/taxes/tax-filing-status) page for more information.
 
**Important: Your SSN/ITIN must be on file with the university prior to December 31 in order to have it reported on your form for that tax year.**
 
### Instructions for Verifying the Information the University has on Record for You
 
- Clear your Cache before logging in to CalCentral 
- Log in to [CalCentral(link is external)](https://calcentral.berkeley.edu/) 
- Click on your student profile picture at the top right of the page 
- Click on the 'Personal Profile' link 
- Review the SSN/ITIN information on the Personal Details page 
- Please note only the last four digits will be displayed for security purposes
 
For information on how to update your name and address, please visit the [Your Name on Records and Rosters(link is external)](https://registrar.berkeley.edu/academic-records/your-name-on-records-rosters/) page.
 
#### If No SSN/ITIN Information is Available
 
If no SSN/ITIN information is available, you can update the information through your CalCentral profile:
 
- Click the 'Update My SSN' button to add your SSN/ITIN to your profile 
- Enter your SSN/ITIN carefully 
- Once the information is saved, you will not be able to make additional edits through CalCentral 
- Click the 'Update' button to save the information
 
#### If the SSN/ITIN on Your CalCentral Profile is Incorrect
 
If the SSN/ITIN on your CalCentral profile is incorrect, or if you are no longer an active UC Berkeley student, you may not have the option to update the information online:
 
- Please complete the [Request for Social Security or Taxpayer ID Number form (PDF file)(link is external)](https://registrar.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/UCB_OR_SSN_110916.pdf) 
- For security reasons, do not email your SSN/ITIN 
- Return the completed form along with a copy of your Social Security Card by one of the following methods: 
- By Mail: 
- Academic Records – Office of the Registrar
 University of California
 124 Sproul Hall
 Berkeley, CA 94720-5404 
- In Person: 
- Cal Student Central 
120 Sproul Hall 
Hours: 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays (closed Wednesdays) 
- Via Fax: 
- 510 643 4222

Saba Yaseri (she/her) is a fourth-year transfer student studying Sociology, Psychology, and Public Health. She served as a Golden Bear Orientation Leader in Summer 2025 before joining the Student Coordinator team for Fall 2025. She also works as a student assistant with the L&S 198 team, supporting transfer students as they navigate their transition to Berkeley.
 
She became a Student Coordinator to help create a welcoming environment and foster a strong sense of belonging for incoming students, while continuing to build meaningful connections within the Berkeley community. In her free time, Saba enjoys playing the piano, playing tennis, and spending quality time with her friends and family.

## Content

[![decorative image](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Sophia-Website.png)]([[Sophia Danna - Golden Bear Orientation]]) 
Onboarding Analyst | sophia_esme@berkeley.edu
 
Sophia joined the New Student Services team in June 2025 as the Onboarding Analyst. Originally from Watsonville, California, her journey has profoundly shaped her passion for educational equity and drives her commitment to advocating for nontraditional and first-generation students. After participating in the first Golden Bear Orientation as an incoming transfer student parent, Sophia is excited to contribute to the same inclusive and empowering New Student Services team that welcomed her. Sophia holds a degree in Sociology from the University of California, Berkeley, and obtained her Master’s in Counseling from San José State University. Outside of work, Sophia enjoys baking, coffee, exploring new places with her family, and hiking.

# Staff & Faculty Volunteer Opportunities - Golden Bear Orientation

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/how-to-get-involved/staff-faculty-volunteer-opportunities](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/how-to-get-involved/staff-faculty-volunteer-opportunities)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.644Z

## Content

## Be a Volunteer
 
![A GBO volunteer giving directions to a new student](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/IMG_6475_775x575.jpg)
 
Looking for a way to give back to our community and help our students? Volunteer to help welcome our new students, move our students in, and orient them to campus at the start of the fall semester!
 
Our goal is to create opportunities for new students to engage with each other and the campus community, help students understand academic requirements and campus resources, and most importantly, welcome students into the Berkeley community.
 
Much of our success is attributed to the participation and collaboration of our campus community: faculty and staff, as well as [[Student Leaders - Golden Bear Orientation|continuing students]].
 
## How to Volunteer
 
No matter how much time you have or what level of involvement you can do, we welcome and appreciate your volunteering with us.
 
Volunteer opportunities for Fall 2026 may include:
 
- Welcoming families as they arrive for Parent & Supporter Orientation in the Pauley Ballroom 
- Helping students navigate lines at Golden Bear Orientation (GBO) Check-In and Move-In 
- Connecting students to their Orientation Leaders (OLs) at GBO Grouping 
- Welcoming students as they enter the Haas Pavilion for the Chancellor’s New Student Convocation event
 

 
[Sign up to volunteer by August 10th](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10C0B44A8AC29A1FAC61-64291596-fall#/)

3239983aa2f83b90.content:
# Student Leaders - Golden Bear Orientation

- **Source URL**: [https://orientation.berkeley.edu/about-us/student-leaders](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/about-us/student-leaders)
- **Crawled At**: 2026-07-09T06:43:01.648Z

## Content

![Photo of five student coordinators sitting on a concrete ledge](https://orientation.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/coords-300x232.png)
 
We’re glad you want to be a GBO leader; you can gain new experiences in a number of ways:
 
- helping new students feel a sense of belonging at Cal 
- leadership development 
- networking and connecting 
- representing Berkeley and New Student Services 
- getting campus recognition, and more
 
*“The reason I stayed involved in GBO is because the program is so important for first year students, transfer students, and re-entry students alike to start off their time at this University with a community that will support them throughout their time at Cal.”* — Nate G., Chemistry & MCB, Orientation Leader, Mentor, Coordinator
 
Want to be the first to know when the GBO Leader Application is live? Sign up with our interest form:
 
[GBO Leader Interest Form](https://bit.ly/gboleaderinters25)
 
You can be involved with Golden Bear Orientation in one of four ways:
 
## Orientation Leaders
 
This is the first step of involvement! If you have a desire to represent UC Berkeley and to grow as a leader, this is a great role for you.
 
As an Orientation Leader, you are a member of a diverse student team that works collaboratively to welcome, orient, and educate over 9,000 new students to campus. You guide a small group of new students through their GBO experience, helping them explore academic life, involvement, the diverse community, and everything that UC Berkeley has to offer.
 
*“I found my sense of belonging and community after joining orientation. I pushed myself to try and join something on campus where they radiated so much positivity.”*— Paulina D., Anthropology, Orientation Leader, Mentor, Coordinator
 
## Orientation Mentors
 
In this mid-level leadership position, you mentor a group of Orientation Leaders as well as train them in leadership development.
 
Mentors serve as the behind-the-scenes programming crew throughout GBO and are expected to take a two-unit course in the spring as part of their mandatory training. Successful candidates must have been Orientation Leaders or Office Representatives.
 
*“This all started when someone walked up to me holding out a flier and told me, ‘You look like a leader.’ Being a GBO leader gave me everything the ad said it would.”* — Marcus P., Political Science & Economics, Orientation Leader, Mentor, Coordinator
 
## Student Coordinators
 
Student Coordinators, under the supervision and direction of the New Student Services staff, serve as role models to Orientation Mentors and Orientation Leaders, as well as all of the new students.
 
As a Student Coordinator, you work throughout the academic year and summer to help with all aspects of GBO, ranging from staff recruitment and selection and program planning, development, and execution. Successful candidates must have been an Orientation Mentor.
 
*“I became a student coordinator because GBO has transformed how I view Berkeley, so I wanted to be part of the process that transforms the culture on campus. GBO has become a really inclusive space, but we still have room to grow and make sure everyone on campus feels like they belong in our community.”* — Renuka G., Economics and Statistics, Orientation Leader, Mentor, Coordinator
 
## Student Representatives
 
We hire Office Representatives to work throughout the spring and summer to provide quality customer service to incoming students who contact NSS with questions and concerns. They help with general office duties including answering phone calls, emails, making copies, preparing program materials, etc. Successful applicants must have previously worked with New Student Services. Applications are open to previous employees of New Student Services; hiring takes place in the spring semester.
 
*“If there is one thing I know I’ve done right at Cal, it is being a part of New Student Services and this amazing program.”* — Elena C., History, Orientation Leader, Mentor, Coordinator

# Student Loan Entrance and Exit Counseling Student Billing

- **Source URL**: [https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/loan-services-and-repayment/student-loan-entrance-and-exit-counseling](https://studentbilling.berkeley.edu/loan-services-and-repayment/student-loan-entrance-and-exit-counseling)

## Content

[## Perkins and HPSL Loan Entrance Counseling
   (link is external)](https://www.ecsi.net/promuc1/)       [## Perkins and HPSL Loan Exit Counseling
   (link is external)](https://heartland.ecsi.net/)       [## Federal Direct Loan Entrance and Exit Counseling
   (link is external)](https://studentaid.gov/)       
## Entrance Counseling
 
Students who will be borrowing a federal loan for the first time (i.e., Federal Direct Loan or Health Professions Student Loan) at UC Berkeley must complete an Entrance Loan Counseling prior to loan disbursement. This requirement is mandated by federal regulation.
 
The Entrance Loan Counseling gives us and the Department of Education the opportunity to inform you of your rights and responsibilities as a recipient of a federal student loan. Likewise, it gives you the chance to make sure you understand the terms and conditions of the loan and to seek answers to any questions you might have before incurring a debt. So, even though it’s a federal requirement, we think it’s also a good idea!
 
As you go through the loan process, it’s a good idea to create a loan file for your personal recordkeeping. Place a copy of the completed Entrance form in your file along with copies of your promissory notes and other loan information. Use this file to store all future materials, documents, and correspondences related to your federal student loans.

## Exit Counseling
 
If you graduate, withdraw, or drop below half-time registration status, and you have borrowed a Federal Direct, Health Professions, or Perkins loan, you must complete the Exit Loan Counseling requirement. This is an opportunity to remind yourself of your rights and responsibilities as a student loan borrower. In turn, you must provide your lender with certain information about your plans after you leave school (for example, your current address, your expected employer, two personal references, etc.).
 
Completing the Exit requirement is only one step in keeping your loans in good standing. Remember that student loan indebtedness is reported to credit agencies. Until your loan is paid in full, you should continue to communicate with your lender regarding any changes in your address, school enrollment status, or questions about making repayment.
 
If you do not know what type of loans you borrowed while in attendance at UC Berkeley, please visit the [US Department of Education Federal Student Aid(link is external)](https://studentaid.gov/) website. You may also call the Customer Service Center:
